content:
🌎 Different cultures, but one community. ❤️

What a beautiful celebration! Our 3rd International Cultural Festival brought together so many cultures, countries, and traditions in a joyful celebration of friendship and community.

From 4 to 7, the excitement never stopped! Colorful traditional clothing, wonderful dance performances, delicious food, and smiling faces filled the afternoon. Everyone proudly shared their heritage while celebrating together under the American flag, here in our shared home of Texas. 🇺🇸

Our heartfelt thanks go to our organizing committee and every volunteer whose hard work and care made this day possible. To all the countries and cultural communities represented: thank you for sharing your food, music, dances, and traditions with such generosity and pride. And to everyone who joined us—thank you for bringing your warmth and friendship!

This celebration reflected the heart of Peace Academy of West Texas: bringing people together, learning from one another, and building lasting friendships.

Different cultures. One community. Beautiful memories together. 💙

#PeaceAcademyOfWestTexas #DifferentCulturesOneCommunity #InternationalCulturalFestival #OdessaTX

content:
🌍💃 The world dances in Odessa!

Join us at the International Cultural Festival for Turkish Zeybek & Kids’ Erik Dalı, Tajik Children’s Dance, Kyrgyzstan’s Kochmondor Dance, and performances representing Mexico, China, India, the Philippines, Ecuador, Nigeria, Gambia, Iraq, and Jordan—plus a special Navajo Nation blessing ceremony!

📅 Saturday, October 24, 2026
🕓 4:00–7:00 PM
📍 Odessa College Downtown Greenspace

🎤 Want to represent your country through dance or song? Please message us to join!

( OUR FESTIVAL IS FREE!
🎉 FREE ADMISSION • FREE FOOD • EVERYONE IS WELCOME!)

Bring your family and celebrate cultures from around the world! 🎉

content:
🏆 A wonderful night for the Peace Academy family!

Peace Academy of West Texas was honored as Nonprofit Partner of the Year at the Odessa Hispanic Chamber of Commerce’s 50th Anniversary Excellence Awards & Gala!

Thank you to the Chamber for their kind words and to everyone who voted for us. We share this honor with our volunteers, friends, and supporters. 💙

We were also happy to invite everyone to our International Cultural Festival on October 24! 🌎

#PeaceAcademyWestTexas #OdessaHispanicChamber #InternationalCulturalFestival
